heroLead: Questions matched to each student’s topic and level, automatic grading, and a mastery map that tells you what to teach next.
s1Title: A test in ten seconds. A different variant for everyone.
s1Text: Pick a topic, difficulty and length. The platform assembles a variant from the bank or generates new problems whose answers are verified by computation, not by eye.
s2Text: Students submit and see a walkthrough at once. Numbers, fractions, text, matching, ordering — eight question types are scored on the server; answers never reach the browser early.
s3Title: Not an average. A map of what the student really knows.
s3Text: The model accounts for difficulty, recency and the amount of evidence. A topic with few answers is marked “not enough data”, not “weak”. What fades comes back for review.
bento1Text: Recommendations follow the topic graph: foundations first.
bento2Text: One button — ten problems exactly where the gap is.
bento3Text: Students solve on the bus. Answers save themselves, even on a flaky connection.
bento4Text: After a lesson, homework is assigned in one click from the lesson’s topics.
bento5Text: Section estimates with an honest ± range.
finalTitle: Your first test in two minutes.
finalLead: Free. No card. Nothing to install.
footer: Made for tutors who’d rather not spend evenings marking notebooks.
